meta.name: feature-forge
meta.description: Conducts structured requirements workshops to produce feature specifications, user stories, EARS-format functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and implementation checklists. Use when defining new features, gathering requirements, or writing specifications. Invoke for feature definition, requirements gathering, user stories, EARS format specs, PRDs, acceptance criteria, or requirement matrices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求讨论变成结构化的功能规格文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把模糊想法变成清晰的功能规格
copy.tagline_en: Turn requirement discussions into structured feature specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn vague ideas into clear feature specifications

howto.what: Claude会开一个结构化需求研讨会:通过提问了解你的目标用户、业务价值和优先级,然后产出一份规格文档,里面包含功能需求(EARS格式)、验收标准、错误处理和实施清单。
howto.when: 当你说要定义新功能、收集需求或编写规格说明等需求相关任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我定义一个新功能的需求规格
say.note: Claude会开始提问并产出规格文档

say.text: 把登录功能写成EARS格式的需求
say.note: 会按EARS语法输出功能需求

say.text: 为这个功能列出验收标准
say.note: 会生成Given/When/Then格式的验收标准

howto.what_en: Conducts a structured requirements workshop, asking questions to understand goals, users, and priorities, then produces a spec document with EARS-format requirements, acceptance criteria, error handling, and implementation checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to define a new feature, gather requirements, or write specifications, among other requirements-related tasks.

say_en.text: Help me define a feature specification for a new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions and produce a spec document.

say_en.text: Write the login feature as EARS-format requirements.
say_en.note: Outputs functional requirements in EARS syntax.

say_en.text: List acceptance criteria for this feature.
